dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「くすん……」

アメリカのスワットチームの勢いで扉をぶち開
ける。
dialogues.en: "Nemu!?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu!?"

dialogues.jp: 肩で息をしながら呟く。
dialogues.en:
I barged into our house like a member of a SWAT team on a
mission.
dialogues.text:
I barged into our house like a member of a SWAT team on a
mission.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ど、どうしたの兄さん、忘れ物？　……あ、
　でも今日は入学式だけだから忘れ物なんてな
　いし……」
dialogues.en: "!? Niisan?"
dialogues.text: "!? Niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 目元をこすって音夢が笑う。
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 「忘れ物だ」
dialogues.en: I mumbled while I caught my breath.
dialogues.text: I mumbled while I caught my breath.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「成績表でも忘れたの？　でも、そんなの明日
　でもいいよね」
dialogues.en:
"What happened? Did you forget something? But there's
nothing to forget since you only have the entrance ceremony
today......"
dialogues.text:
"What happened? Did you forget something? But there's
nothing to forget since you only have the entrance ceremony
today......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったり」
dialogues.en: She rubbed her eye and smiled.
dialogues.text: She rubbed her eye and smiled.

dialogues.jp: 壁によりかかってズルズルと床に座り込む。
dialogues.en: "I forgot something."
dialogues.text: "I forgot something."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、本当にどうしたの？」
dialogues.en:
"Did you forget your school record? But you could bring it
tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"Did you forget your school record? But you could bring it
tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Phew...... what a pain."
dialogues.text: "Phew...... what a pain."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が時計を見る。
dialogues.en: I sat on the floor and leaned against the wall.
dialogues.text: I sat on the floor and leaned against the wall.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ、もう入学式始まっちゃってない！？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 俺も時計を見ながらうなずく。
dialogues.en: "Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうみたいだなって……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no. The ceremony would have started by now!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, no. The ceremony would have started by now!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の驚いたような、呆れたような声。
dialogues.en: "Well, that's right...... I have an idea."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's right...... I have an idea."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 俺はにっこりと笑う。
dialogues.en: I smiled.
dialogues.text: I smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「ここで入学式をやろう」
dialogues.en: "Let's do the ceremony here."
dialogues.text: "Let's do the ceremony here."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がびくりと肩を震わせる。
dialogues.en: Nemu shook her shoulders.
dialogues.text: Nemu shook her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「どうせ学園でやってるのなんて形ばっかりな
　んだ。ここで心をこめてやるほうがいい」
dialogues.en:
"The ceremony at school is so formal. We should have our own
ceremony here."
dialogues.text:
"The ceremony at school is so formal. We should have our own
ceremony here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに……バカなこと言ってるの兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺を誰だと思ってるんだ。お祭りの時にさり
　げなく意外なことをするお前の兄貴だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Who do you think you're talking to? It's your brother who
acts unexpectedly at the festivals."
dialogues.text:
"Who do you think you're talking to? It's your brother who
acts unexpectedly at the festivals."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当にバカなこと言ってないで学園に行きな
　さい！」
dialogues.en: "You must be crazy, you have to go back to school!"
dialogues.text: "You must be crazy, you have to go back to school!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「行けるかバカッ！！」
dialogues.en: "I can't go, idiot!!"
dialogues.text: "I can't go, idiot!!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の怒鳴り声に、音夢が目を丸くして動きを止
める。
dialogues.en: Nemu froze, opening her eyes widely as I yelled out.
dialogues.text: Nemu froze, opening her eyes widely as I yelled out.

dialogues.jp: 気が付くと立ち上がっていた。
dialogues.en: I stood up unexpectedly.
dialogues.text: I stood up unexpectedly.

dialogues.jp: 「あー……いや、叫んで悪ぃ」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... sorry I yelled."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... sorry I yelled."

dialogues.jp: ばつが悪くて頭をかいて座りなおす。
dialogues.en: I felt embarrassed and scratched my head and sat down again.
dialogues.text: I felt embarrassed and scratched my head and sat down again.

dialogues.jp: 「確かにバカは俺なんだ」
dialogues.en: "I'm really stupid."
dialogues.text: "I'm really stupid."

dialogues.jp: 「お前をこんな日にこそ置いていくなんてな」
dialogues.en: "To leave you alone on a day like this......"
dialogues.text: "To leave you alone on a day like this......"

dialogues.jp: 「恋人失格だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not a good boyfriend."
dialogues.text: "I'm not a good boyfriend."

dialogues.jp: にへへ、と苦笑いが漏れる。
dialogues.en: I smiled wryly.
dialogues.text: I smiled wryly.

dialogues.jp: 口元を押さえて音夢が息をのむ。
dialogues.en: She gulped air in covering her mouth with her hand.
dialogues.text: She gulped air in covering her mouth with her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ……音夢」

「俺はお前と……いや、お前は俺と本校に通う
　ことは出来ないんだ」
dialogues.en: "I can't...... no, you can't go to school with me."
dialogues.text: "I can't...... no, you can't go to school with me."

dialogues.jp: この胸の痛さはどちらのものか……。
dialogues.en: My heart ached. Who's the one having this ache?
dialogues.text: My heart ached. Who's the one having this ache?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「知ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "I knew it."
dialogues.text: "I knew it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「知ってるよ。だから兄さん……そんなに傷つ
　かないで」
dialogues.en: "I know that already. So, don't feel bad, niisan......"
dialogues.text: "I know that already. So, don't feel bad, niisan......"

dialogues.jp: そっ、と音夢の手に導かれる。
dialogues.en: Nemu took me in her hands gently.
dialogues.text: Nemu took me in her hands gently.

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっ、と身体が痛いほど音夢に抱きしめられ
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu held me tightly.
dialogues.text: Nemu held me tightly.

dialogues.jp: そうやって心を慰められる。
dialogues.en: She tried to comfort me.
dialogues.text: She tried to comfort me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「夢うつつだったけど、兄さんとさくらの話は
　聞こえてた」
dialogues.en:
"I overheard the conversation you and Sakura had while I was
asleep."
dialogues.text:
"I overheard the conversation you and Sakura had while I was
asleep."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね兄さん……私のせいで」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, niisan...... It's my fault."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, niisan...... It's my fault."

dialogues.jp: 傷つけてもかまわない──。
dialogues.en: "It's not your fault."
dialogues.text: "It's not your fault."

dialogues.jp:
そう思っていたはずなのに、この期に及んでも、
俺は音夢を抱きしめ返すことができなかった。
dialogues.en: I knew I wasn't supposed to, but I held her tightly as well.
dialogues.text: I knew I wasn't supposed to, but I held her tightly as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ううん……ごめんね兄さん……どんなに嘘つ
　かれても、距離をとられても私はダメなの」
dialogues.en:
"No, I'm sorry. I can't help it even if you lie to me, or
keep away from me."
dialogues.text:
"No, I'm sorry. I can't help it even if you lie to me, or
keep away from me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんが素っ気なくしても、バカって言って
　いても、心の底でやさしさと辛さが分かっちゃ
　うの」
dialogues.en:
"I know how kind and hurt you are even if you act cold to
me, or call me an idiot."
dialogues.text:
"I know how kind and hurt you are even if you act cold to
me, or call me an idiot."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「恋人がこんな私だなんて……ごめ……ごめん
　なさい！」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry that I'm your girlfriend...... I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry that I'm your girlfriend...... I'm sorry......"

dialogues.jp: 肩が冷たくなる。
音夢の震えが直接伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: My shoulders became wet and cold.
dialogues.text: My shoulders became wet and cold.

dialogues.jp:
身体にも心にも、｛おんさ／音叉｝が共鳴するように俺の心
もさざめく。
dialogues.en: I could feel her shivering.
dialogues.text: I could feel her shivering.

dialogues.jp: 言葉はいらなかった。
dialogues.en:
My heart reacted like a tuning fork and it shook my body and
soul.
dialogues.text:
My heart reacted like a tuning fork and it shook my body and
soul.

dialogues.jp: お互いの心が伝わっている。
dialogues.en: We didn't need words.
dialogues.text: We didn't need words.

dialogues.jp: やさしい嘘もつけず。
dialogues.en: We knew how we felt about each other.
dialogues.text: We knew how we felt about each other.

dialogues.jp: 容赦のない真実もつけない。
dialogues.en: We couldn't keep up a lie to protect each other.
dialogues.text: We couldn't keep up a lie to protect each other.

dialogues.jp: とめどなく涙が溢れてくる。
dialogues.en: We couldn't overlook the truth as well.
dialogues.text: We couldn't overlook the truth as well.

dialogues.jp: 喉がひきつることだけは我慢する。
dialogues.en: We cried like there was no tomorrow.
dialogues.text: We cried like there was no tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: 俺が悲しむことは、音夢の悲しみに伝わる。
dialogues.en: I try not to make it obvious.
dialogues.text: I try not to make it obvious.

dialogues.jp:
歯をくいしばって、楽しいことだけを考えるよ
うにする。
dialogues.en: If I'm sad, Nemu will catch on to my sadness.
dialogues.text: If I'm sad, Nemu will catch on to my sadness.

dialogues.jp: 音夢だけを守ろうと誓う。
dialogues.en: I tried my best to think about happy thoughts.
dialogues.text: I tried my best to think about happy thoughts.

dialogues.en: I swear I'll protect Nemu.
dialogues.text: I swear I'll protect Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「嬉しいよぉ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, niisan...... I want you to love me, for now."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, niisan...... I want you to love me, for now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Don't let me go......"
dialogues.text: "Don't let me go......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "I can't help it......"
dialogues.text: "I can't help it......"

dialogues.jp: ◆２人きりの入学式◆
dialogues.en: ◆Our own ceremony◆
dialogues.text: ◆Our own ceremony◆

dialogues.jp:
家に帰ると、ことりの指摘通り音夢が寂しさに
泣いていた。
dialogues.en:
I came back home to find Nemu crying, as Kotori said she
would be.
dialogues.text:
I came back home to find Nemu crying, as Kotori said she
would be.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりだけの入学式をしようという俺の言葉に、
音夢は泣き出してしまう。
dialogues.en:
Nemu started crying as I said we should have our own
entrance ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Nemu started crying as I said we should have our own
entrance ceremony.

dialogues.jp:
そして、自分の病気のことで俺に迷惑をかけて
いると、今度こそ本当に泣き出してしまった。
dialogues.en:
And she really cried as she said she's making trouble for me
by being sick.
dialogues.text:
And she really cried as she said she's making trouble for me
by being sick.
